javanese: logika
rationale: Direct scholarly and official orthographic evidence.

javanese: logika formal
rationale: Phrase directly observed; English definitions govern technical details.

javanese: himpunan; teori himpunan naif
rationale: No qualifying Javanese set-theory witness was found. Kumpulan has only ordinary gathering senses in the checked dictionary and is retained as negative evidence. The official borrowing rule, government-edited Javanese mathematics use of international terms, and direct scholarly use of teori support the borrowing pattern, while each mathematical sense is defined from OpenLogic rather than Indonesian. The complete term remains provisional and reversible.

javanese: anggota; unsur (definitional synonym)
rationale: General member lexeme attested; formal membership defined directly from OLP-0005. Token element renders anggota for both number forms; introductory synonym unsur is a declared borrowing.

javanese: ekstensionalitas
rationale: The international technical stem remains a controlled borrowing. OLP-0005 defines the exact biconditional, and OLP-0013 uses extensionality only to show that two unequal candidate sets cannot both be identical to one order relation; no canon passage is claimed to attest the set-theoretic sense.

javanese: subhimpunan
rationale: Subhimpunan remains a transparent controlled compound under the documented borrowing practice, but no inspected canon source directly attests it. OLP-0006 defines it exactly by element inclusion and its notation.

javanese: subhimpunan sejati
rationale: The term is retained only as a source-defined specialization: OLP-0006 requires both subset inclusion and inequality. No canon passage is claimed to establish sejati as a mathematical properness marker.

javanese: himpunan pangkat
rationale: The controlled calque is defined in OLP-0006 as the set of all subsets. JV-P018 is only a negative control for the numerical power sense of rambang; no inspected canon passage attests the full set-theory term.

javanese: yen lan mung yen
rationale: The explicit composition preserves both implications and is never collapsed to yen. General academic conditional and definitional syntax is attested, but the formal connective phrase remains controlled by the English definitions and formulas.

javanese: kosong
rationale: Empty set has no members; empty string has length zero. Keep distinctions in definitions.

javanese: bukti / buktekna
rationale: General bukti homonym 2 and verbal form attested. Formal mathematical argument sense derives from source. Unaccented e follows edition policy.

javanese: bener / salah
rationale: Bebener and contrasting kleru provide general truth-vocabulary evidence; use bener and salah consistently in formal contexts. No formal truth-value canon attestation claimed.

javanese: wilangan natural
rationale: Wilangan is directly attested and the borrowing strategy is documented, but the complete mathematical phrase is not canon-attested. The OLP-0007 display explicitly includes 0, preventing any silent positive-only convention.

javanese: wilangan wutuh
rationale: Wilangan is directly attested; wutuh has its ordinary whole sense. Their mathematical compound remains source-defined by the OLP-0007 integer display, including negatives and zero.

javanese: wilangan rasional / wilangan real
rationale: The recognizable international stems follow the bounded borrowing policy and occur alongside an attested number headword. OLP-0007 fixes their basic scope. OLP-0043 constructs each rational as an equivalence class of integer pairs with nonzero second coordinate, defines arithmetic and order on representatives, and embeds each integer as the class of its pair with 1. These exact sets and operations come from the source definitions and formulas rather than the canon; no native Javanese foundations attestation is claimed.

javanese: winates / tanpa wates / bab tanpa wates / tanpa wates kang nyata
rationale: Kang tanpa wates is directly attested only for general boundlessness, and the academic passages support prose register rather than foundations terminology. Finite-cardinal, infinite-sequence, infinity, and especially medieval actual-infinity senses remain defined by the exact English source, examples, and formulas. Tanpa wates kang nyata is retained as a high-uncertainty historical descriptor, not a claimed conventional term, and remains open to expert replacement if a Javanese higher-mathematics witness establishes one.

javanese: rerangken / urutan
rationale: OLP-0007 defines a finite string as a finite sequence over an alphabet and separately defines one-way infinite sequences. General academic ordering and boundlessness language is supported, while the computer-science distinction and rerangken term remain source-defined and provisional.

javanese: gabungan / irisan
rationale: The terms remain controlled regional borrowings rather than canon-attested Javanese set terminology. OLP-0008 defines union with inclusive OR and intersection with AND, including binary, family, and indexed forms; the formulas control their exact meanings.

javanese: selisih himpunan / pisah
rationale: OLP-0008 defines directional A minus B as A-members not in B and defines disjoint by empty intersection. The former awkward ora uga dadi wording has been removed. Neither full term is claimed as directly canon-attested.

javanese: pasangan urut / tupel / produk Kartesius
rationale: OLP-0009 defines ordered pairs by Wiener--Kuratowski, left-associates longer tuples, and defines the Cartesian product as all pairs with first coordinate in A and second in B. The international terms follow bounded borrowing practice but are not claimed as canon-attested Javanese mathematics terminology.

javanese: paradoks / teori himpunan naif
rationale: Teori is attested and the borrowing policy is documented, while the full mathematical compounds remain source-defined. OLP-0010 supplies Russell's contradiction and explains genuinely naive as lacking precise existence axioms, not as an insult or a claim of careless mathematics.

javanese: wilangan sampurna / wilangan kang mbagi tanpa turah nanging dudu wilangan iku dhewe
rationale: Perfect number remains a controlled source-defined specialization. The unsupported Indonesian-shaped pembagi sejati calque was removed; the proper-divisor condition is now stated directly as numbers that divide without remainder and are not the number itself. The government-edited arithmetic witness attests dipara and ora turah, while the exact mathematical condition remains controlled by OLP-0005.

english: relation / binary relation / bears a relation
javanese: relasi / relasi biner / relasi lumaku antarane objek
rationale: General relasi is directly observed in Javanese scholarly prose; OLP-0012 defines the binary mathematical sense as a subset of A squared. Ambiguous passive diduweni renderings were replaced by explicit holds-between language or, for relations viewed as sets, contains-pairs language so argument roles cannot reverse.

javanese: refleksif / irrefleksif / transitif
rationale: No inspected canon passage attests the formal relation senses. OLP-0014 defines them by exact quantified conditions: reflexive requires every diagonal pair, irreflexive excludes every diagonal pair, and transitive requires Rxz whenever Rxy and Ryz. The revised wording makes each condition explicit and does not equate irreflexive with merely not reflexive.

javanese: simetris / antisimetris / asimetris
rationale: The three borrowings name three distinct source-defined quantified conditions in OLP-0014. Symmetry reverses every related pair; antisymmetry permits both directions only on the diagonal and may coexist with symmetry; asymmetry forbids both directions for every pair. Revised conditional clauses keep those distinctions explicit; no native formal-relation attestation is claimed.

javanese: koneks / tatanan / tatanan ketat
rationale: OLP-0014 defines a connected relation by comparability of every pair of distinct elements; reserve kasambungan graf for graph connectivity. OLP-0016 defines the complete order hierarchy and the strict-order conditions. Tatanan and koneks remain source-defined editorial specializations; the inspected canon does not attest them as order-theory terminology.

english: identity relation / universal relation / empty relation
javanese: relasi identitas / relasi universal / relasi kosong
rationale: OLP-0012 defines the identity relation by the diagonal, the universal relation by A squared, and the empty relation by the empty set. Their explanations now say that the set representation contains every or no ordered pair. General relation vocabulary is attested, while the three formal compounds remain provisional.

javanese: komprehensi / kontradiksi / aksioma
rationale: The terms follow the bounded technical-borrowing strategy but are not directly attested in a Javanese foundations canon. OLP-0010 fixes the comprehension, Russell-contradiction and axiom senses. In OLP-0044, the two irrationality arguments both conclude a contradiction with the assumed reduced fraction; the former Kosok balen wording was removed because it denotes reversal or contrast rather than a derived contradiction. The source proofs and formulas control the logical sense.

javanese: teorema / proposisi / definisi / rekursif
rationale: The international technical stems remain controlled borrowings within attested academic prose architecture. Environment labels retain source hierarchy; in OLP-0013, proposisi means the content expressed by a predicate-bearing sentence and differs from a numbered proposition environment. The exact technical senses remain source-defined.

english: equivalence relation / equivalence class / quotient / partition
javanese: relasi ekuivalensi / kelas ekuivalensi / kuosien / partisi
rationale: OLP-0015 defines an equivalence relation by reflexivity, symmetry, and transitivity; its equivalence class is exactly the set of related elements and its quotient is the set of all such classes. OLP-0042 applies that construction to integer differences, and OLP-0043 applies it to integer fractions by identifying pairs exactly when their cross-products agree. General relation and academic classification prose are attested, but the four mathematical compounds and these quotient constructions remain source-defined provisional borrowings.

english: preorder / partial order / total or linear order
javanese: pratatanan / tatanan parsial / tatanan total utawa linear
rationale: OLP-0016 preserves the exact hierarchy: reflexive plus transitive gives a preorder; adding antisymmetry gives a partial order; adding connectedness gives a total or linear order. Strict forms remain separately marked. Pra- plus tatanan is an explicit editorial coinage, not alleged established terminology.

javanese: tutupan refleksif / ekstensi / perangan wiwitan
rationale: OLP-0016 directly defines sequence extension and initial segment, and defines reflexive closure by adding the diagonal to a strict order. The converse removes the diagonal. OLP-0045 consistently uses perangan wiwitan sejati for a proper initial segment of the rationals and immediately fixes it by the strict-subset formula and downward-closure condition. The operations and formulas control these specialist meanings; no inspected canon passage attests them as order-theory terminology.

javanese: graf / graf mawa arah / simpul / rusuk
rationale: OLP-0017 defines a directed graph as a vertex set together with an edge relation contained in its square. The carrier is explicit, so isolated vertices distinguish graphs that share the same edge relation. General relation and academic prose are attested, while the graph-theory terms remain source-defined provisional borrowings.

english: tree / root / ancestor / child / parent / branch / subtree
javanese: wit / oyod / leluhur / anak / induk / pang / subwit
rationale: OLP-0018 defines every graph- and order-theoretic role and controls the specialist senses. The canon supports borrowing policy, relation vocabulary, and continuous scholarly definition prose, but it does not attest this tree-theory family; the native metaphors therefore remain explicit, reversible source-defined specializations.

english: least element / well-ordered / successor / predecessor / chain
javanese: anggota paling cilik / katata kanthi becik / panerus / pandhisik / rantai
rationale: The exact OLP-0018 definitions control: least compares with every carrier element, well-order quantifies over each nonempty subset, successor and predecessor are immediate cover roles, and a branch is a maximal chain. Anggota is lexically attested and the canon supports relation and scholarly-definition prose, but no passage attests the complete order-theory compounds.

english: inverse / relative product / restriction / application / transitive closure
javanese: invers / produk relatif / watesan / aplikasi / tutupan transitif
rationale: OLP-0019 fixes every operation by formula: inverse swaps coordinates; relative product composes R then S through an existential middle element; restriction intersects R with A squared; application collects related outputs; transitive closure unions positive powers; reflexive-transitive closure adds the identity. The canon supports borrowing policy, anggota, relasi, and scholarly definition prose but not these specialist operation senses. R+ is section-local and differs from its reflexive-closure use in OLP-0016, as the reader errata states.

javanese: nyabang winates
rationale: OLP-0018 immediately defines nyabang winates as every node having finitely many successors. That local definition prevents confusion with finite branch length or finitely many total branches. Canon supports borrowing policy, academic definition syntax, and the ordinary boundlessness phrase, but does not attest the coined tree-theory term; no attestation is claimed.

javanese: formula / derivasi / kelengkapan / logika tataran kapisan
rationale: Formula, derivasi, and kelengkapan remain controlled technical adaptations; tataran kapisan is a descriptive choice, and derivasi stays distinct from bukti. The canon attests logika and logika formal, borrowing policy, and sustained technical prose, but no preserved passage attests the complete logic-foundations family used in OLP-0018-P005; its exact source-defined use therefore remains provisional.

javanese: fungsi / pemetaan
rationale: Fungsi is directly attested only in a general purpose/use sense. OLP-0021 controls the mathematical sense by mapping every domain member to one specific codomain member and repeatedly requires one and only one value for each argument. Pemetaan is retained as a controlled technical borrowing within that definition; no formal-function attestation is inferred from the general canon.

english: domain / codomain / range / argument / value / input / output
javanese: domain / kodomain / jangkauan / argumen / nilai / masukan / asil
rationale: OLP-0021 fixes the roles by definition and diagram: the domain supplies inputs or arguments, the codomain supplies possible values, and the range contains exactly attained values. Asil describes output and nilai the assigned value. General fungsi and academic prose are attested, but no passage attests this full mathematical vocabulary; codomain and attained range remain explicitly distinct.

english: surjective / injective / bijective; surjection / injection / bijection
javanese: surjektif / injektif / bijektif; surjeksi / injeksi / bijeksi
rationale: OLP-0022 fixes the three senses by exact quantifiers: surjective requires at least one preimage for every codomain member, injective permits at most one, and bijective requires both. The worked constant, identity, successor, and parity functions preserve the distinctions. Source token keys and flags continue to select Javanese adjective and noun forms. Canon supports borrowing policy, general fungsi and academic prose, but no passage attests these mathematical terms or korespondensi siji-menyang-siji.

javanese: graf fungsi; fungsional; citra
rationale: The canon supports scholarly register, controlled borrowing, membership language, and general relasi/fungsi usage only; it does not independently attest these exact mathematical senses. OLP-0023 defines a graph as a subset of A times B, functional as exactly uniqueness plus totality, and image as the attained-value set. OLFUN-004 and OLFUN-005 remain explicitly disclosed critical source exceptions rather than evidence of source-target parity.

english: inverse; left inverse; right inverse; composition
javanese: invers; invers kiwa; invers tengen; komposisi
rationale: The canon supports academic and proof register, controlled borrowing, and general relation/function vocabulary, but it does not attest these exact mathematical senses. OLP-0024 fixes left and right by the displayed cancellation equations, and OLP-0025 fixes composition order as first f then g. OLFUN-001 remains an explicitly disclosed critical source exception: the translated theorem uses the simple nonempty-domain correction and its adjacent note gives the exact condition A nonempty or B empty.

english: partial function; total; defined; undefined; serial
javanese: fungsi parsial; total; ditetepake; ora ditetepake; serial
rationale: The canon supports scholarly prose, controlled borrowing, membership language, and general relasi/fungsi usage, but not these exact mathematical senses. OLP-0026 directly defines a partial function by at most one output, its actual domain by defined inputs, total by every ambient input, and seriality by existence of an output for each input. At most one remains distinct from exactly one.

javanese: wilangan; cacah; jinis
rationale: Freshly read recovered official KBJI originals confirm these lexical senses. They do not attest every mathematical compound. Preserve OpenLogic Nat including zero; old textbook wilangan asli excluding zero is not imported.

english: multiplication; division; divisibility without remainder; numerical sum; remainder
javanese: ping-pingan; para/paran; paran tanpa turah; gunggung; turah
rationale: Recovered dictionary HTML confirms the operation senses, while government-edited Javanese mathematics prose directly uses ping-pingan, dipara, and turah in calculations. OLP-0015 uses dipara and turah in modular arithmetic. OLP-0016 names divisibility provisionally as paran tanpa turah and defines n divides m by n mbagi m tanpa turah and m=kn; that specialist relation name is source-defined, not directly attested. Pamara means way of dividing, not divisor; total-function and union terminology are separate.

english: numerical power; power set; algebraic or logical term
javanese: rambang (numerical alternative); himpunan pangkat (retained); term (provisional technical borrowing)
rationale: Rambang directly attests equal-factor numerical powers, not powersets. Keep prior himpunan pangkat decision. The dictionary's suku entry lacks an algebraic or logical sense, so OLP-0055 and the formal-logic chapters use the international stem term as an explicitly provisional borrowing; exact formation rules, not the canon, control its technical meaning. Recovered rambang original HTML itself flattens its displayed example to 43; never use that as mathematical evidence.

javanese: enumerasi; bisa didhaptar; enumerabilitas; bisa dietung (countable sense, source-defined)
rationale: The canon directly supports general number/count vocabulary and scholarly prose, not countable infinity or enumeration theory. OLP-0027 preserves the elementary list-or-surjection-from-positive-integers approach and the attributed bijection-with-Nat-or-an-initial-segment alternative. OLP-0029 controls the family by an informal list with every member at a finite position, a formal surjection from positive integers for nonempty sets, a separate empty-set case, the equivalent natural-number and finite-initial-segment formulations, and an explicit equation between the tokenized enumerable label and bisa didhaptar. OLP-0031 keeps enumerable unions distinct from finite unions and explicitly states the needed choice assumption for an arbitrary indexed family. OLP-0038 gives the set-theoretic alternative directly: an enumeration is a bijection whose domain is either all natural numbers or a finite initial segment, while the empty set is handled separately; the equivalent natural-number surjection and injection characterizations remain explicit. OLP-0039 proves non-enumerability by showing that every proposed Nat-indexed list omits a constructed element, for both infinite binary sequences and the powerset of Nat. OLP-0040 transfers a hypothetical powerset enumeration through a surjective characteristic-sequence map and thereby reduces enumeration of Bin^omega to enumeration of Pow(Nat). Avoidable active and passive verb forms built on enumerasi are replaced by direct Javanese listing language or menehi/diwenehi enumerasi tumrap. No computability requirement is introduced. The family remains high-uncertainty and reversible rather than conventionally attested.

javanese: fungsi pambunderan munggah
rationale: OLP-0029 and OLP-0038 both describe rounding upward to the nearest integer and preserve the ceiling brackets, alternating integer values, and even/odd piecewise definition. The OLP-0029 table also retains the audited missing-value correction. The government-edited mathematics passages support arithmetic register only; no specialized Javanese ceiling-function attestation or pronunciation certification is claimed.

javanese: fungsi pasangan; ngodeake; kode; ngudhari kode
rationale: OLP-0031 defines a pairing function broadly as an injection from A times B into Nat and defines a code as its value on a pair. Its final exercise now enumerates the range before applying the inverse and separately handles an empty product. OLP-0032 gives the bijective code h(n,m)=2^n(2m+1)-1 and separately the injective positive code j(n,m)=2^n3^m, explicitly noting that a nonsurjective encoding has only a partial inverse. These constructions control the coding direction; no native Javanese coding-theory attestation is claimed.

javanese: kowinates; komplemen
rationale: Kowinates adapts the co- prefix to ko- plus the chosen winates form. OLP-0031 explicitly defines a subset of Nat as cofinite exactly when its complement within Nat is finite. OLSIZ-002 supplies the omitted subset relation in the frozen prose; neither the definition nor the correction treats Nat itself as finite. No native Javanese topology or set-theory attestation is claimed.

english: array; row; column; triangular number; numerical power
javanese: larikan rong dimensi; baris; kolom; wilangan segitiga; rambang
rationale: In OLP-0030, larikan rong dimensi remains an explicit high-uncertainty descriptive form fixed by the displayed grids, row and column coordinates and axis labels; no native array-theory attestation is claimed. OLP-0031 corrects the frozen strict triangular-number bound to an inclusive bound, matching the sequence 0, 1, 3, 6 and k(k+1)/2, while retaining wilangan segitiga as source-defined terminology. Gunggung supports numerical sum and rambang directly supports numerical powers; rambang is not transferred to powersets. English ordinal th in OLP-0031 is rendered by preceding kaping, with an empty text-only TeX exponent to preserve structure without residual English.

javanese: tabel kabeneran; fungsi kabeneran
rationale: General truth and function vocabulary does not attest these formal compounds. OLP-0031 defines the relevant truth functions as every function from a finite bit power to one bit for some finite arity, then asks for enumerability of their union. The formulas control the specialist sense; no native Javanese logic-textbook attestation is claimed.

javanese: ora bisa didhaptar; metodhe diagonal; diagonalisasi
rationale: OLP-0033 defines non-enumerability through the absence of a surjection from the positive integers and then proves it with two list-dependent diagonal constructions. JV-D015 now qualifies the surjection characterization to nonempty enumerable sets and explains beside the claim that the empty set is enumerable although no function from the positive integers to it exists. OLP-0039 repeats the two arguments under the Nat-bijection convention. OLSIZ-008 corrects s_n(m) to the mth digit of the nth string, matching row n and column m; OLSIZ-009 gives the complementary flips 1 to 0 and 0 to 1, matching the case formula. The five existing row-break-plus-hline byte sequences remain untouched because OLSIZ-011 was conclusively retracted as a false positive. In both units the constructed sequence or subset differs from every indexed proposal. Ora bisa didhaptar remains a descriptive rendering and the diagonal terms remain provisional borrowings; no native Javanese set-theory attestation is claimed.

javanese: reduksi; ngreduksi
rationale: OLP-0034 fixes the reduction direction operationally: an enumeration of A is transformed into one of B by a surjection A to B, so enumerating B reduces to enumerating A. OLP-0040 restates that direction under the alternate enumeration convention and instantiates it with the surjection sending each subset of Nat to its characteristic binary sequence. A hypothetical enumeration of Pow(Nat) would then enumerate all Bin^omega, contradicting the preceding theorem. The harmless N_1 list index shift is retained, while OLSIZ-010 replaces the frozen unbound output s_k with one sequence s throughout. Exercises preserve every source and target space. Avoidable ngenumerasi forms are replaced by menehi enumerasi tumrap or direct enumerasi tumrap constructions, while reduksi and ngreduksi remain adapted provisional borrowings under the orthographic policy. No effective or computable reduction condition is implied and no native Javanese computability-theory attestation is claimed.

javanese: padha cacahe; gedhene himpunan; ora luwih gedhe tinimbang; luwih cilik tinimbang
rationale: General cacah and number vocabulary support only ordinary counting language. OLP-0035 defines padha cacahe exactly by a bijection and verifies the equivalence-relation laws. OLP-0036 defines ora luwih gedhe tinimbang by an injection and luwih cilik tinimbang by an injection with no bijection, with the needed Choice qualification on its unrestricted non-enumerability characterization. OLP-0037 states Schröder-Bernstein: opposite injection comparisons yield padha cacahe. OLP-0054 proves it by a closure-based sandwich lemma and two compositions. Its nested two-argument cardeq macro invocation expands to the valid chain A approximately B approximately C, so the central malformed-formula finding is rejected by the declared macro definition and complete proof. Gedhene Himpunan remains a high-uncertainty pedagogical heading, and no native attestation of transfinite cardinality is claimed.

english: source repairs in Functions: left inverse, principal square root, input variable, graph relation, function restriction
javanese: A ora kosong; oyod kuadrat utama kang ora negatif; x ajeg; relasi antarane A lan B kang kaemot ing A×B; watesan fungsi mung ing koordinat masukan
rationale: Apply the five bounded English-source corrections visibly in OLP-0021, OLP-0023, and OLP-0024 without changing frozen English bytes. OLFUN-002's nonnegative principal root and OLFUN-003's consistent x remain critical source-target formal exceptions in the owner repair evidence, rather than ordinary parity. The simple left-inverse theorem requires nonempty A and its adjacent note records the exact condition A nonempty or B empty. Function restriction remains domain-only. This source audit is not Javanese canon or retrospective language consultation.

javanese: aritmetisasi
rationale: Aritmetisasi adapts the international technical stem under the checked borrowing policy. OLP-0041 fixes its chapter-local sense as the construction of multiple number systems within naive set theory, with ordered imports for integers, rationals, reals, cuts, reflections, detail checking and Cauchy sequences. It does not mean assigning Goedel numbers to syntax here. The canon supports academic prose, borrowing and general number vocabulary, but no native Javanese foundations text directly attests this specialist term.

english: construction of integers as equivalence classes; embedding natural numbers as integers
javanese: pambangunan wilangan wutuh minangka kelas ekuivalensi; nganggep wilangan natural minangka wilangan wutuh
rationale: OLP-0042 represents an integer difference a-b by the ordered pair (a,b), identifies pairs exactly when a+d=c+b, verifies reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity, and defines Int as the quotient of Nat squared by that relation. Addition, multiplication and order are then defined on equivalence classes. The embedding n_Int=[n,0] preserves addition, multiplication and order while maintaining the philosophical distinction that the constructed natural-number objects are not literally the integer equivalence classes. The canon supports academic prose, general member/relation/function/number language and arithmetic register, but no native Javanese foundations witness directly attests this quotient construction or canonical embedding.

javanese: wilangan irasional
rationale: Wilangan has a direct general number sense and irasional is an adapted international stem under the borrowing policy. OLP-0044 fixes the formal sense as a real number outside the rationals, then proves that square root of two has that status by geometric descent and the even-numerator/even-denominator contradiction. No specialized native Javanese attestation is claimed.

javanese: lapangan katata
rationale: The existing ordering vocabulary combines with a provisional adapted field term. OLP-0044 says only that the rationals and reals are ordered fields and directs readers to the exact later definition; it does not silently supply or alter the field axioms. The canon supports borrowing and scholarly exposition but does not attest this mathematical compound.

english: Completeness Property; upper bound; lower bound; least upper bound; greatest lower bound
javanese: Sipat Kajangkepan; wates ndhuwur; wates ngisor; wates ndhuwur paling cilik; wates ngisor paling gedhe
rationale: OLP-0044 defines completeness compositionally and exactly: every nonempty set of reals that has an upper bound has a least upper bound. Its rational counterexample has upper bounds but no least rational upper bound. OLP-0045 uses the dual greatest-lower-bound phrase while motivating cuts. Capitalization marks the named property. The canon supports number vocabulary and academic definition prose, while ordinary jangkep does not itself attest this technical property.

english: continuum; gap in the rational line
javanese: kontinuum; longkangan ing garis rasional
rationale: Kontinuum preserves the recognized technical stem, while longkangan retains OLP-0044's explicitly quoted spatial metaphor for the rationals' failure of completeness. The least-upper-bound example and later cut construction supply the mathematical content. No inspected canon passage is claimed to attest the full formal metaphor.

javanese: potongan; potongan-potongan (pambangunan Dedekind)
rationale: The official dictionary directly records potongan with an ordinary cut or slice sense. OLP-0045 alone controls the formal Dedekind sense by three exact conditions: a nonempty proper initial segment of the rationals with no greatest member. Inclusion orders the cuts, and the union proof verifies all three conditions before proving leastness. The Indonesian dictionary definition is lexical scope evidence rather than a semantic pivot, and no native Javanese real-analysis attestation is claimed.

english: embed the rationals into the reals
javanese: nyisipake wilangan rasional menyang wilangan real
rationale: OLP-0045 fixes the map exactly: rational p is represented by the cut of all rational q below p. Nyisipake is a transparent description of that structure-preserving representation rather than literal physical insertion; later verification controls preservation of the operations and order. No specialized native Javanese attestation is claimed.

english: numbers or relations are sets, metaphysically speaking; treat them as sets; embed their theories
javanese: wilangan utawa relasi iku himpunan saka sisi metafisika; nganggep wilangan utawa relasi minangka himpunan; nyisipake teori-teorine
rationale: OLP-0013 distinguishes a metaphysical identity assertion from the weaker mathematical practice of treating certain relations as sets. OLP-0046 makes the parallel distinction for numbers: alternative ordered-pair implementations produce different set objects, natural zero is not literally the constructed integer zero, and the warranted conclusion is only that set theory lets us treat the numbers as sets and embed their theories. OLP-0053 adds that any Dedekind algebra exemplifies the desired natural-number structure and that all such algebras are isomorphic, while expressly withholding an answer about which objects are the natural numbers; the embedding is also conditional on a Dedekind-infinite set. General relasi, wilangan, konteks, and teori have canon support, while no Javanese canon source is claimed to settle the philosophy of mathematics.

javanese: ring komutatif; ring katata
rationale: OLP-0047 fixes the two structures by formula: the commutative ring has eight displayed laws, and the ordered ring adds a total order compatible with addition and multiplication by nonnegative elements. Ring is retained as an internationally recognizable algebraic borrowing and katata follows the established ordering vocabulary. The canon supports formal-logic and scholarly definitional register plus general relation language, but it does not attest these algebraic compounds as conventional Javanese.

english: associativity; commutativity; identity; additive inverse; distributivity; multiplicative inverse
javanese: asosiativitas; komutativitas; identitas; invers aditif; distributivitas; invers multiplikatif
rationale: OLP-0047 places these six adapted labels beside the exact ring and field formulas, so each label's algebraic role is fixed without relying on lexical resemblance. Exact QA treats only the labels as language-bearing text and preserves every variable, operator and alignment token. The canon supports controlled borrowing and scholarly exposition but does not directly attest the specialized algebraic labels.

javanese: trikotomi (koneksitas tatanan total)
rationale: OLP-0047 explicitly glosses trichotomy as connectedness for a total order and retains the three exclusive comparison cases in the adjacent formula.
